howToPlay:
🧠 HOW TO PLAY?

1. Observe & Memorize: Numbers are scattered randomly at the start. Commit their positions to your memory well!

2. Make Your Move: Tap on number 1 when you are ready.

3. The Memory Test: Watch out! As soon as you tap the first number, all others will hide! 🫣 You must find the remaining numbers (2, 3, 4...) in order using your memory.

📈 Levels:
🟢 Beginner: 5 Numbers
🟡 Intermediate: 10 Numbers
🟠 Hard: 12 Numbers
🔴 Master: 15 Numbers

⏳ Time & Second Chance:
Out of time? Don't worry! Watch a short ad to gain +30 seconds and continue exactly where you left off. 📺

🏆 Leaderboard:
Tap the Crown 👑 icon on the home screen to check your rank and compete to make it into the Top 10 players!
